children: The French Treasury Agency will launch a new bond indexed to eurozone inflation at an auction on Sept. 17, it said Friday.
The following are details of the coming auction.

Date of auction      Sept. 17, 2026 
Issue                2.10% March 1, 2037 OATei 
Amount on offer      EUR2 bln-EUR2.5 bln 
Settlement date      Sept. 21, 2026
Write to Emese Bartha at emese.bartha@wsj.com
